status.en: 35 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 21% fewer than the week before, most of them in Kordofan, Darfur and Khartoum.
status.nb: 35 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 21 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Kordofan, Darfur og Khartoum.

summary.en: The RSF has stepped up drone attacks that have knocked out power in southeast Sudan and hit markets and hospitals, worsening civilian casualties and limiting medical care. The UK has sanctioned Sudanese commanders for their role in a rape campaign in El Fasher, and the UAE is being blamed for fueling bloodshed in the conflict. Refugee camps in Darfur now host the children of those who fled, while gold miners continue to work under dangerous, laborious conditions. The conflict has caused 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: RSF har økt droneangrep som har slått ut strømmen i sør-øst Sudan og rammet markeder og sykehus, noe som forverrer sivile tap og begrenser medisinsk behandling. Storbritannia har sanksjonert sudanske kommandanter for deres rolle i en voldtekampanje i El Fasher, og De forente arabiske emirater blir beskyldt for å bidra til blodbadet i konflikten. Flyktningleirer i Darfur huser nå barna til dem som flyktet, mens gullgruvearbeidere fortsetter å jobbe under farlige, arbeidskrevende forhold. Konflikten har forårsaket 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Sudanese civil war (2023–present)
background.extract: Since April 2023, there has been a civil war in Sudan between the two main factions of the country's military government. The conflict involves the internationally recognized government of Sudan led by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), under General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan; against the rival Government of Peace and Unity led by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary group, commanded by General Hemedti. Smaller armed groups have also taken part on both sides, most notably Sudan Liberation Movement splinter groups, the Tamazuj militia, and the Darfur Joint Protection Force.
background.extractNb: Konflikten i Sudan 2023 er en pågående væpnet konflikt mellom rivaliserende fraksjoner i Sudans regjering som brøt ut den 15. april 2023 over hele landet. Konflikten er hovedsakelig i hovedstaden Khartoum og i Darfurregionen.
